== relaxed files ==
-- json --

  "output_mode": "files_with_matches",
  "files": [
    {
      "repo": "test/repo",
      "path": "a.go"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "truncated": false,
  "relaxed_query": "IndexRepo symbolSections",
  "dropped_terms": [
    "zzznotaterm"
  ]
}

      "after": "\n"

      "column": 4,

== parameter names ==
-- json --
{
  "output_mode": "files_with_matches",
  "total": 0,
  "truncated": false,
  "zero_result_hint": {
    "parsed_query": "(and (or file_substr:\"output_mode\" content_substr:\"output_mode\") (or file_substr:\"context_lines\" content_substr:\"context_lines\"))",
    "repos_searched": 0,
    "repos_discovered": 1,
    "term_counts": [
      {
        "term": "output_mode",
        "files": 0
      },
      {
        "term": "context_lines",
        "files": 0
      }
    ],
    "notes": [
      "\"output_mode context_lines\" is made of csl_search parameter names, not search terms; pass them as parameters (e.g. output_mode=\"content\") and put the text to find in query",
      "no term matches any file under these filters; check each term's spelling and the filters before retrying"
    ]
  }
}
-- text --
no matches
parsed query: (and (or file_substr:"output_mode" content_substr:"output_mode") (or file_substr:"context_lines" content_substr:"context_lines"))
files per term: output_mode=0, context_lines=0
repos searched: 0 (0 indexed, 1 discovered)
- "output_mode context_lines" is made of csl_search parameter names, not search terms; pass them as parameters (e.g. output_mode="content") and put the text to find in query
- no term matches any file under these filters; check each term's spelling and the filters before retrying

== repo filter matches none ==
-- json --
{
  "output_mode": "files_with_matches",
  "total": 0,
  "truncated": false,
  "zero_result_hint": {
    "parsed_query": "(and (or file_substr:\"zzznotaterm\" content_substr:\"zzznotaterm\") repo:(?i)nomatch)",
    "repos_searched": 0,
    "repos_discovered": 1,
    "notes": [
      "repo filter \"nomatch\" matched none of the 1 locally discovered repos; check the name with csl_repo_lookup — if the repo is not checked out locally, csl cannot see it, so search it where it is hosted instead of retrying here"
    ]
  }
}
-- text --
no matches
parsed query: (and (or file_substr:"zzznotaterm" content_substr:"zzznotaterm") repo:(?i)nomatch)
repos searched: 0 (0 indexed, 1 discovered)
- repo filter "nomatch" matched none of the 1 locally discovered repos; check the name with csl_repo_lookup — if the repo is not checked out locally, csl cannot see it, so search it where it is hosted instead of retrying here

== syntax traps ==
-- json --
{
  "output_mode": "files_with_matches",
  "files": [
    {
      "repo": "test/repo",
      "path": "a.go"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "truncated": false,
  "relaxed_query": "| x",
  "dropped_terms": [
    "\"IndexRepo Blocks\"",
    "OR",
    "zzz"
  ]
}
-- text --
relaxed: dropped '"IndexRepo Blocks"', 'OR', 'zzz' (0 files each); showing results for `| x`

test/repo/a.go

1 file

== too many terms ==
-- json --
{
  "output_mode": "files_with_matches",
  "total": 0,
  "truncated": false,
  "zero_result_hint": {
    "parsed_query": "(and (or file_substr:\"a\" content_substr:\"a\") (or file_substr:\"b\" content_substr:\"b\") (or file_substr:\"c\" content_substr:\"c\") (or file_substr:\"d\" content_substr:\"d\") (or file_substr:\"e\" content_substr:\"e\") (or file_substr:\"f\" content_substr:\"f\") (or file_substr:\"g\" content_substr:\"g\"))",
    "repos_searched": 0,
    "repos_discovered": 1,
    "term_counts": [
      {
        "term": "a",
        "files": 2
      },
      {
        "term": "b",
        "files": 2
      },
      {
        "term": "c",
        "files": 2
      },
      {
        "term": "d",
        "files": 1
      },
      {
        "term": "e",
        "files": 2
      },
      {
        "term": "f",
        "files": 2
      }
    ],
    "notes": [
      "query has 7 AND terms and only the first 6 were counted, so nothing was dropped automatically; remove the terms with 0 files and retry with at most 2 terms"
    ]
  }
}
-- text --
no matches
parsed query: (and (or file_substr:"a" content_substr:"a") (or file_substr:"b" content_substr:"b") (or file_substr:"c" content_substr:"c") (or file_substr:"d" content_substr:"d") (or file_substr:"e" content_substr:"e") (or file_substr:"f" content_substr:"f") (or file_substr:"g" content_substr:"g"))
files per term: a=2, b=2, c=2, d=1, e=2, f=2
repos searched: 0 (0 indexed, 1 discovered)
- query has 7 AND terms and only the first 6 were counted, so nothing was dropped automatically; remove the terms with 0 files and retry with at most 2 terms

== shape "" ==
query is empty; put the text to search for in query
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query is empty",
  "hint": "put the text to search for in query"
}

== shape "   " ==
query is empty; put the text to search for in query
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query is empty",
  "hint": "put the text to search for in query"
}

== shape "\"" ==
query "\"" is only quote characters; put the search term itself in query; quotes are only needed around a multi-word phrase, e.g. "retry backoff"
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query \"\\\"\" is only quote characters",
  "hint": "put the search term itself in query; quotes are only needed around a multi-word phrase, e.g. \"retry backoff\""
}

== shape "\"\"" ==
query "\"\"" is only quote characters; put the search term itself in query; quotes are only needed around a multi-word phrase, e.g. "retry backoff"
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query \"\\\"\\\"\" is only quote characters",
  "hint": "put the search term itself in query; quotes are only needed around a multi-word phrase, e.g. \"retry backoff\""
}

== shape "foo \"bar" ==
query has an unbalanced double quote; close the phrase ("exact phrase") or remove the stray quote
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query has an unbalanced double quote",
  "hint": "close the phrase (\"exact phrase\") or remove the stray quote"
}

== shape "foo\\" ==
query ends with a lone backslash; double it (\\) to match a literal backslash, or remove it
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query ends with a lone backslash",
  "hint": "double it (\\\\) to match a literal backslash, or remove it"
}

== shape "foo \"\" bar" ==
query contains an empty quoted phrase ""; put the phrase text inside the quotes or drop them
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "query contains an empty quoted phrase \"\"",
  "hint": "put the phrase text inside the quotes or drop them"
}

== shape "retry f:\\.go$ \"back off\" -test" ==
ok
{
  "valid": true,
  "parsed": "(and (or file_substr:\"retry\" content_substr:\"retry\") file_regex:\"\\\\.go(?m:$)\" (or file_substr:\"back off\" content_substr:\"back off\") (not (or file_substr:\"test\" content_substr:\"test\")))",
  "terms": [
    "retry",
    "\"back off\""
  ],
  "filters": [
    "f:\\.go$",
    "-test"
  ]
}

== shape "output_mode" ==
ok
{
  "valid": true,
  "parsed": "(or file_substr:\"output_mode\" content_substr:\"output_mode\")",
  "hint": "\"output_mode\" is made of csl_search parameter names, not search terms; pass them as parameters (e.g. output_mode=\"content\") and put the text to find in query",
  "terms": [
    "output_mode"
  ]
}

== shape "sym:(Hello|Point)+" ==
ok
{
  "valid": false,
  "error": "sym:case_regex:\"(?:Hello|Point)+\" repeats an alternation, which zoekt's symbol matcher cannot run and csl cannot split",
  "hint": "write one sym: term per alternative joined with lowercase or: (sym:Foo or sym:Bar)"
}

  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {

      "description": "group matches by: repo or language; empty returns a single total",

      "description": "restrict to files of this language",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "query": {
      "description": "zoekt query (same syntax as csl_search)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "repo": {
      "description": "restrict to repo names matching this case-insensitive regex (a plain substring also works)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "response_format": {
      "description": "output encoding: text | json | jsonl | toon | csv | markdown-kv | xml; omit to use the configured default (config.yaml mcp.response_format, built-in text)",

== schema csl_hybrid_search ==
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "description": "extra lines of source context around each semantic chunk snippet (default 0)",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "lang": {
      "description": "restrict to a single language (e.g. go, typescript, python)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "limit": {
      "description": "maximum number of fused file results to return (default 50)",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "query": {
      "description": "what you are looking for; matched both literally (lexical) and by meaning (semantic)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "repo": {
      "description": "restrict to a repo: the lexical side treats this as a case-insensitive regex, the semantic side as a case-sensitive substring; a plain repo name like 'mad01/csl' satisfies both",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "response_format": {
      "description": "output encoding: text | json | jsonl | toon | csv | markdown-kv | xml; omit to use the configured default (config.yaml mcp.response_format, built-in text)",
      "enum": [
        "text",
        "json",
        "jsonl",
        "toon",
        "csv",
        "markdown-kv",
        "xml"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "rrf_k": {
      "description": "Reciprocal Rank Fusion smoothing constant (default 60); lower favors top-ranked outliers, higher favors cross-backend consensus",
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}

== schema csl_search ==
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "case_sensitive": {
      "description": "force case-sensitive matching; default is smart case (case-insensitive unless the query has uppercase)",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "context_lines": {
      "description": "number of context lines around each match in content mode (default 0); ignored in files_with_matches mode",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "file": {
      "description": "restrict to file paths matching this regex (e.g. paths ending in .go)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "lang": {
      "description": "restrict to files of this language (e.g. go, swift, python)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "limit": {
      "description": "maximum number of file results (default 50)",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "offset": {
      "description": "skip this many ranked file results before applying limit, to page past the first limit results (default 0); ranking is stable across calls, so successive pages line up",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "output_mode": {
      "description": "files_with_matches (default) returns unique file paths; content returns matching lines with context",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "query": {
      "description": "zoekt query: literal / regex / 'phrase' / AND (space) / OR (|) / NOT (-) / sym: (definitions only) / repo: / file: / lang: / case:yes",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "repo": {
      "description": "restrict to repo names matching this case-insensitive regex (a plain substring also works)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "response_format": {
      "description": "output encoding: text | json | jsonl | toon | csv | markdown-kv | xml; omit to use the configured default (config.yaml mcp.response_format, built-in text)",
      "enum": [
        "text",
        "json",
        "jsonl",
        "toon",
        "csv",
        "markdown-kv",
        "xml"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
null
